ModMetaData.name: Dried Fish
ModMetaData.author: Russell
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a fish drying rack: a standalone building that turns any fish into shelf-stable dried fish, the fishing culture's answer to jerky.
Measures its input in nutrition rather than item count, so it handles every fish correctly - vanilla, modded, and the double-nutrition "adept catches" from Vanilla Ideology Expanded.
Drying is time-based and climate-dependent, modelled on North Atlantic stockfish: fastest just above freezing, slower in deep cold, slower still in warmth, stopped by rain, and ruined by real heat.
No Harmony patching. Requires Vanilla Fishing Expanded for its fish (or Odyssey).
